title: Rep. Max Miller’s ex-wife sues after sensitive image of child was publicly shared
description: The Ohio Republican had released documents through a publicly accessible Dropbox account this month, seeking to fend off allegations of domestic abuse.

title: Ex-Southern Poverty Law Center official indicted over payments to informants
description: Prosecutors say Heidi Beirich was romantically involved with an informant who was receiving payments. Her lawyer called the case an effort to “silence political opponents.”

title: White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt to leave administration
description: She will leave the administration at the end of August, President Donald Trump announced in a post on Truth Social on Wednesday.

title: How mainstream Democrats pulled off a big upset against a democratic socialist
description: Supporters and detractors agreed that voters appeared to be increasingly worried over whether Hong could beat GOP nominee Tom Tiffany.

title: Wisconsin surprise raises big questions about polls and Democratic voters
description: Surveys had shown Francesca Hong with a significant lead in the Democratic primary for governor. Then she lost. What did the polls get wrong?

title: Minnesota is first state to set all-female matchups for the biggest races
description: Democratic Lt. Gov. Peggy Flanagan and Republican Michele Tafoya are running for Senate, while Sen. Amy Klobuchar (D) and state House Speaker Lisa Demuth are running for governor.

title: Democratic strategist reflects on Wisconsin and Minnesota primaries
description: NPR's Juana Summers speaks with Amanda Litman, co-founder of the PAC Run For Something, about the results from the Aug. 11 Democratic primary elections.

title: Trump sued over service selling faster access to Truth Social posts
description: The federal lawsuit alleges that the service from the president's media company violates the Constitution. Meanwhile, Trump Media executives say they have signed up more than 10 customers.

title: White House press secretary leaving
description: Karoline Leavitt will continue to be an outside adviser, Trump said

title: With Crowley atop their ticket, Wisconsin Democrats hope for a 2026 sweep
description: The party establishment is breathing a sigh of relief that democratic socialist Francesca Hong, who led the pre-election polls by double-digits, will not be topping their ticket.

title: Takeaways from the primaries in South Carolina, Wisconsin, Minnesota and Connecticut
description: Democrats fought over age and ideology, while Republicans tested the value of President Donald Trump’s endorsement.

title: Trump says Secret Service told him to switch planes because of threat
description: In his first public comments on the operation, the president downplayed the risks to officials and journalists who remained on Air Force One for the flight from Turkey.

title: Are data centers enough to flip a key House race?
description: Democratic and Republican candidates nationwide are running on their opposition to data center projects.

title: Pirro, in rare move, convenes special grand jury in Washington
description: Unlike typical grand juries, those designated as special focus on a single case or related cases and can issue a report following their investigation.

title: Close aides, but no Cabinet officials, joined Trump in airport catering truck
description: The president was accompanied by some of his most loyal aides but no top administration officials as he made the clandestine move to a different plane to leave Turkey last month.

title: Andrew Tate's extradition fight tests his influence with Trump's America
description: After President Trump took office, Andrew Tate proclaimed, "The Tates will be free." A year later, Tate is being held in federal prison after he was arrested following a U.K. extradition request.

title: Report suggests a threat forced Trump to switch aircraft as he departed NATO summit
description: President Trump boarded Air Force One last month as usual. But the Washington Post reports he was smuggled off the plane in a catering truck and flew on an entirely different aircraft due to a threat.

title: Former Secret Service agent discusses Trump's Air Force One switch
description: NPR's Michel Martin speaks with former Secret Service agent Robert McDonald about reports that President Trump boarded a military aircraft instead of flying aboard Air Force One from Turkey.

title: Four takeaways from Tuesday's primaries in six states
description: Voters in Wisconsin, Minnesota and several other states went to the polls Tuesday, and results highlight the ongoing conflicts within both parties ahead of November's midterms.

title: In Wisconsin, David Crowley defeats Francesca Hong in Democratic primary for governor
description: David Crowley is the Milwaukee County Executive and could become the state's first Black governor. He narrowly defeated Francesca Hong, a democratic socialist who drew enthusiastic support.

title: President Trump appears, and briefly stars, at his Patriot Games
description: The three-day athletic event in Ohio featured dodgeball, tug-of-war and a lot of praise for the president. Just don't tell anyone who won.

title: Trump administration to end Medicaid funding for children’s transgender care
description: The administration of President Donald Trump has escalated its crackdown on transgender medical care ahead of the midterm elections.

title: Pentagon report reveals steep civilian toll of Trump’s Yemen campaign
description: The military operation was the first following Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth’s dismantling of an office focused on mitigating unintended casualties.

title: Progressive Peggy Flanagan wins Democratic Senate primary in Minnesota
description: Progressive Lt. Gov. Peggy Flanagan won the Democratic primary for Senate from Minnesota. It continues a series of wins for the progressive wing of the party over centrists.

title: Trump-backed Mike Lindell loses primary for Minnesota governor to Lisa Demuth
description: Lindell had President Trump's endorsement but he lost to Lisa Demuth, the speaker of the state house. She'll face Democratic Sen. Amy Klobuchar in the fall for governor.

title: Democrats demand briefing on Trump’s secret flight from Turkey
description: Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer said the White House kept Congress “in the dark” about last month’s ruse to avoid an Iranian threat.

title: Rule could let parents put $2,500 into child ‘Trump accounts’ tax-free
description: Proposed guidance from the Treasury Department clarifies how employer and employee contributions to the new accounts would work.

title: House Democrats seek records in dropped Reflecting Pool case against ex-Olympian
description: Rep. Jamie Raskin sent a letter to the Justice and Interior departments pressing for more information on the felony prosecution of David Hearn.

title: National Democrats step up support for Rep. Max Miller’s opponent
description: The Ohio Republican denies his ex-wife’s abuse allegations, but Democratic nominee Brian Poindexter has been added to the party’s “Red to Blue” program.

title: Human rights groups sue Trump administration over International Criminal Court sanctions
description: The president signed an executive order in 2025 placing sanctions on the ICC, whose jurisdiction the U.S. does not recognize.

title: In a partisan age, a Democratic governor goes outside her brand for a running mate
description: Arizona Gov. Katie Hobbs (D), facing a tough reelection fight, chose former mayor John Giles, a lifelong Republican who recently became an independent.

title: The data center backlash is building
description: Just in time for the midterm elections.

title: North Carolina Republicans pick replacement for embattled Rep. Chuck Edwards
description: State lawmaker Jennifer Balkcom will face Democrat Jamie Ager, a fifth-generation farmer, in November.

title: Here are the races you should watch today
description: Primary season is coming to a close, and today is the most crowded day left on the calendar.

title: Trump-Netanyahu rift widens as election pressures pull them in opposite directions
description: While the Israeli leader touts a willingness to defy the U.S. on Gaza, the president needs to show progress in the foreign entanglements weighing on his approval rating.

title: Trump refuses to back down as Supreme Court blocks major policies
description: The president is seeking ways around rulings on tariffs, birthright citizenship and the Fed. Experts say the moves don’t signal outright defiance, but they push the court’s limits.
